due_when.clears_when: The GLD wedge is root-caused and closed (the row is closed with the correct exit_reason), or it is shown that a stop rests at the venue throughout AND the wedge is a market-closed deferral that clears at the RTH open; or the manager kills it with a stated reason.

origin.rerun: diag_fetch 'journalctl?unit=ict-trader-live&lines=3000' | grep -E 'standing wedge|active close is in flight' ; then alpaca_open_orders for alpaca_paper GLD (is a stop resting?) and journal?table=trades for the open GLD row.

what: alpaca_paper GLD: package pkg-6a8e3fb325464be3 (gld_pullback_1h) is a 'standing wedge'. The order monitor returns verdict close/sl_cross (exit_price 382.95) every ~30 s, and logs 'close RE-PROBE of a standing wedge ... last observed 415.2min ago (re-probe every 60min)' at 2026-09-30 06:18Z. So a stop-cross exit has been wanted for about 7 h without closing. Because of it, the Alpaca naked sweep skips GLD's re-arm on EVERY sweep ('an active close is in flight', now counted as active_close_skipped=1). The same skip already appeared on the 2026-09-29 18:55Z line. A position that the close cannot flatten, and that the sweep will not re-arm, can sit with no resting stop. NOT established: whether GLD currently has a resting stop at the venue, and why the close is wedged (it may be the market-closed deferral; 06:18Z is outside RTH). Paper account, so no real money is at risk, but the same interaction applies on alpaca_live.
